desc: Contained fascia condition showing localized darkened softened wood and peeling paint behind an otherwise intact gutter edge, soffit, and shingle roofline.
reuse_notes: Use for fascia-rot diagnosis, gutter-edge water-path discussion, eave repair planning, and exterior wood-maintenance articles. It shows a bounded repairable condition, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for roof assessment, structural rafter-tail inspection, gutter slope, water-source tracing, permit, or code requirements.
